title: 麻将胡了 2 专属游戏厅背景
intendedUse: 麻将胡了 2 专属子厅背景；网页覆盖标题、玩法介绍和难度选择。
prompt: Create a wide 3:2 premium casual 3D mahjong game room environment for a sequel, visually distinct from a simple jade table. A luminous imperial jade pavilion with ivory-and-gold mahjong tiles floating in a graceful cascading arc through the upper half, layered jade-green screens and soft warm lanterns at the far sides. Tiles remain traditional rectangular mahjong forms with simple non-readable abstract markings. Leave the lower middle 45 percent calm and dark teal for HTML difficulty cards. Match the shared Gameing Hall style: rounded dimensional shapes, smooth polished surfaces, deep teal/jade, ivory and restrained gold, soft upper-left lighting, clean silhouettes, premium friendly casual-game finish.
negativePrompt: photorealism, realistic palace, humans, anime tile portraits, readable Chinese text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, buttons, UI, poker cards, cash, clutter lower center, harsh bloom, flat vector

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Shared finish, palette restraint and soft lighting only; sequel environment must be compositionally distinct.
